learning_objective: 🎯 Let's explore the beautiful classical and folk dances of India and draw their dazzling, colorful costumes!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: India is a huge country with many different states! From the Bhangra in Punjab to the Garba in Gujarat, every place has its own joyful folk dance.
Dancers wear gorgeous, bright clothes that twirl when they spin. They also wear heavy, shiny jewelry and jingling bells called ghungroos on their ankles.
Many dances use exciting props! Some dancers balance pots on their heads, click wooden sticks together, or wear huge, colorful masks to make the show spectacular.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Design a Dancer's Outfit!
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a figure of a dancer and use crayons, glitter, or colored paper cutouts to design the most beautiful, sparkling traditional costume you can imagine!

quick_recap: ⭐ Every state in India has its own unique and beautiful style of dance.
⭐ Dance costumes are brightly colored and full of amazing shiny details.
⭐ Props like sticks, pots, and masks make traditional dances even more exciting.
